item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut suburbs for 1st time since ceasefire was announced
Iran War Live Updates: Tehran Considers U.S. Proposal After Trump Threats
item.description: An Iranian official said Tehran was looking at an American plan to end the war, after President Trump threatened to restart strikes. A U.S. warplane disabled an Iranian-flagged tanker, and Israel struck targets near Beirut.

item.title: Skeletons in their clothing: Recovering bodies from the rubble in Gaza
item.description: It was one of the deadliest Israeli strikes of the Gaza war, devastating one extended family. A year and a half later, the survivors find their loved ones' remains.

item.title: Why the Lebanon-Israel ceasefire is 'in name only'
BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.

item.title: Iran Says It Is Reviewing a U.S. Proposal to End the War
item.description: Nothing was disclosed about the peace plan, and there were conflicting signals from the Iranians about how seriously they were taking it.

item.title: U.S. and Iran exchange taunts as attacks imperil fragile ceasefire
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister warned the U.S. should be wary of being dragged into a “quagmire” after tensions flared in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Trump keeps changing his timeline for ending the Iran war
item.description: The president has repeatedly suggested that the conflict was nearing a conclusion while simultaneously escalating threats against Tehran.
